mapper.select: SELECT FROM content.shot s INNER JOIN content.shot_revision r ON r.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND r.shot_id = s.id AND r.revision = s.current_revision WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{shotId}
